en: Mr. Briney
Ahoy! Shall we sail back to my cottage on Route 104?
Go on and deliver your letter, then. I'll wait right here.
Ahoy! Where shall we sail to?
Route 104
Slateport
Stay here
Just tell me whenever you need to set sail.
Back to the cottage it is! Hold on to your hat!
Slateport it is! Hoist the sails, Peeko!
Mr. Briney
Home sweet home! Whenever you need the sea again, you know where to find me.
Mr. Briney
Land ho! That's Slateport's beach. The city's just to the north. Off you go with your parcel!
I'll wait here. Whenever you want to go back to Dewford, just say so.
Land ho! Slateport, as promised. I'll wait here for whenever you need me.
Fisherman
This is a fishing island, you know. Doesn't the sea make you itch to cast a line?
That's the spirit! Here, take one of my old rods. I've got plenty.
Face the water and use the rod. When something bites, reel it in quick!
No? A shame. The fish around here practically jump onto the hook.
How's the fishing going?
Excellent
Not so good
Keep at it! Different rods bring in different Pokémon. Try every spot you can.
Ha ha! That's what I like to hear. There's a Pokémon out there for every fisher.
Boy
Everyone's talking about fishing right now. It's the biggest thing on the island! You knew that, right?
Of course you did. Anyone who's anyone knows what's in right now.
You didn't know? Come on! Dewford Hall's the place to hear what's popular. Go and listen in.
